plugins.name: doodle-chat
plugins.description: Hand-drawn doodle chat panel for the session area: reproduces the complete-mode ChatPage layout with right-aligned user bubbles, assistant bubbles carrying an avatar label, inline reasoning/tool bubbles, and a handwritten input box with a send button at the bottom.
plugins.description-zh: 手绘涂鸦风格的会话面板：照搬完整模式 ChatPage 的聊天框与消息气泡排版（用户气泡右对齐、助手气泡带头像标签、思考/工具气泡内联，底部为手写输入框与发送按钮）。

plugins.name: doodle-panel-shell
plugins.description: Hand-drawn doodle panel container that lives in the panel-container area: a doodle tab strip hosts every panel-area plugin, each rendered in its own persistent iframe (show/hide only, never reloaded), and relays messages between child plugins and the host.
plugins.description-zh: 手绘涂鸦风格的面板容器（入驻 panel-container 区域）：顶部为涂鸦标签条（自动收纳全部 panel 区域插件），下方展台为每个面板插件各驻留一个独立 iframe（切换仅显隐、不重载），并负责把子插件与宿主之间的消息双向中继。

plugins.name: doodle-session-bar
plugins.description: Hand-drawn doodle session list that merges the session switcher and the pending-approval list into one unified doodle card style: session cards support inline rename/delete, approval cards carry a type tag, an expandable reason, feedback and approve/reject actions.
plugins.description-zh: 手绘涂鸦风格的会话列表：把完整模式的「切换会话」列表与「待审批」列表合并成同一套涂鸦卡片风格，统一排版（会话卡片含行内重命名/删除，审批卡片含类型标签、理由展开、反馈与批准/拒绝）。
